title: Digital Input
text: Read from one or multiple digital input channels, 2 outputs, {Output data type} sets Data type of block output; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Input channels} selects digital input channels and {Channel mode} sets the mode of representing the input. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Digital Data
ports.summary: Digital data read from input channels vector

params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer
